components_strategy.hero_slider: Full width image slider with bg-black/40 gradient overlay. H1 text centered or bottom-left aligned. Smooth crossfade using framer-motion.
components_strategy.venue_cards: Image container with overflow-hidden and hover:scale-105 transition duration-700. Content below image with crisp typography. Badges for capacity/price.
components_strategy.search_filter: Glassmorphism sticky bar (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 border border-white/40). Shadcn select inputs.
components_strategy.testimonials: Bento grid layout. Asymmetrical text blocks with large quote marks.
components_strategy.vendor_dashboard: Clean sidebar layout. Denser F-pattern data entry. 'Add Listing' as a multi-step form or long structured scroll. Status badges using distinct colors.
components_strategy.admin_dashboard: KPI metrics on top row. Data tables with subtle borders. Clear red/green action buttons for approve/reject.
components_strategy.auth_forms: Split screen layout. Left side architectural image, right side clean minimal form.

motion.page_transitions: opacity 0 to 1, y 10 to 0 using framer-motion
motion.hover_states: subtle lift (-translate-y-1) and shadow increase on dashboard cards
motion.scroll: Use Lenis for smooth momentum scrolling on marketing pages

instructions_to_main_agent: Use pure HTML/Tailwind for marketing layout (landing page), avoiding rigid Shadcn layouts there.
Use Shadcn UI components for dashboards and complex forms, customizing border radii and colors to match the theme.
Implement Lucide React icons for all dashboard actions and UI markers.
Ensure the hero slider uses the provided media URLs, with a dark overlay to maintain text contrast (minimum 3:1 ratio).
Inject the custom font imports into the main CSS or index.html.
